heroLead: If you've ever driven the loop around Uniontown and wondered why South Uniontown doesn't show up as its own town on most maps, you're not alone. It's a community, not a municipality, and that quirk matters when you're trying to figure out what your mineral deed actually covers.
intro: South Uniontown is a census-designated place just outside the city of Uniontown, the Fayette County seat. Because it's not a separate incorporated municipality, mineral records for property here are typically filed under Union or German townships depending on exactly where a tract sits, which trips up a lot of families searching the recorder of deeds index for the first time.

Fayette County sits in the Marcellus wet-gas window, and while the busiest drilling in the county has tended to cluster further south and west, unit pooling has reached parcels around Uniontown as operators fill out development plans block by block.

sections.heading: Finding Your Deed When the Town Isn't Official
paragraphs: Because South Uniontown isn't its own municipality, we always confirm the township of record first, usually Union or German Township, before searching deed history. It's a small step but it saves a lot of confusion, and it's exactly the kind of detail a family selling for the first time usually doesn't know to check.

sections.heading: What Determines Value Here
paragraphs: Whether your tract sits inside an active drilling unit is the single biggest factor in what your interest is worth. We check current DEP permits and pooling orders against your specific parcel, review any lease and division order paperwork, and factor in post-production deductions if a well is already producing before we give you a number.

sections.heading: How We Close
paragraphs: Once you agree to a number, we handle the purchase agreement, work with a title company to confirm clean title, and record the transfer properly at the recorder of deeds. Most sales close within a few weeks once title is confirmed.

faqs.question: South Uniontown isn't listed as a borough. Where is my deed actually filed?
faqs.answer: Most likely under Union Township or German Township in the Fayette County recorder of deeds records. We confirm this for you as part of reviewing your interest.

faqs.question: Is my area inside an active drilling unit?
faqs.answer: We check current DEP well and permit data against your specific tract rather than guessing based on general county activity, since it varies significantly parcel to parcel.

faqs.question: How long does closing usually take?
faqs.answer: Once your title is confirmed clean, most closings take a few weeks. Complicated heirship situations can take longer, and we'll walk you through what to expect upfront.
